repo.description:
### Impact

The `cron` plugin utilizes commands in the `app.json` file to manage system cron running as the Dokku user. An `app.json` cron command utilizing special shell characters - including, but not limited to, `>` or `;` - can break out of the Docker container and execute commands on the host as the Dokku user.

This security issue applies to installations that utilize the app.json plugin with it's cron integration and can be exploited by any Dokku user with push access to an application where openresty is the configured proxy.

### Patches

https://github.com/dokku/dokku/pull/8672
repo.summary: OS Command Injection via app.json managed Cron
